license: Written for this repository. No third-party text, no network fetch at run time.
note: A prompt's token count depends on the model's tokenizer, so it is measured per model with the runtime's vocab-only mode and recorded in the campaign, never estimated from characters. Prompts are only the source of text; the cost-table key is the token count that mode reports.

prompts.text: Name three sorting algorithms and state the worst-case running time of each.
A workshop has twelve benches. Each bench seats four people, and two benches are reserved. How many seats remain, and write the arithmetic step by step.

Explain why a memory-bandwidth bound appears in matrix multiplication on a machine whose arithmetic throughput is high but whose memory bus is narrow. Keep the explanation to a few sentences and use a concrete example.
